legal.termsContent:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF USE

1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By accessing and using the Talent Pool platform operated by Career Pilot, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

2. DESCRIPTION OF SERVICE
Talent Pool is an intermediation platform connecting students with companies for internship and professional opportunities.

3. STUDENT PLAN
- Monthly fee: €5 for platform access
- Success fee: €80 if you secure an internship/interview through the Talent Pool
- The success fee is due only once, regardless of the number of months of subscription

4. USER OBLIGATIONS
- Provide accurate and truthful information
- Keep login credentials confidential
- Not use the platform for illegal purposes
- Respect the intellectual property rights of Career Pilot and other users

5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All content on the platform, including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, and software, is the property of Career Pilot.

6. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Career Pilot acts as an intermediary and is not responsible for agreements between students and companies.

7. MODIFICATION OF TERMS
Career Pilot reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be notified of significant changes.

8. APPLICABLE LAW
These terms are governed by Italian law.
legal.privacyContent:
PRIVACY POLICY AND GDPR COMPLIANCE

1. DATA CONTROLLER
Career Pilot is the data controller for personal data collected through the Talent Pool platform.

2. DATA COLLECTED
We collect:
- Personal information (name, surname, email, phone)
- Professional information (CV, cover letter, LinkedIn)
- Payment information (bank transfer receipts)

3. PURPOSE OF PROCESSING
- Platform registration and access management
- Intermediation between students and companies
- Payment management
- Communication of opportunities

4. LEGAL BASIS
- Consent of the data subject
- Execution of the contract
- Legal obligations

5. DATA RETENTION
Data will be kept for the duration of the service and subsequently for the periods required by law.

6. YOUR RIGHTS (GDPR)
You have the right to:
- Access your personal data
- Rectify inaccurate data
- Request deletion of data
- Limit processing
- Data portability
- Object to processing
- Withdraw consent

7. DATA SECURITY
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data.

8. DATA SHARING
- Approved companies have access to student profiles
- Data is not sold to third parties
- Data may be shared with service providers (hosting, payments)

9. CONTACT
For requests regarding your data, contact: privacy@careerpilot.com

10. COMPLAINTS
You have the right to file a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali).
